name: Impenetrable Eyelet
description: Stand with a chain in each hand and the elbows level so each guard stands for the other.

name: Gnashing Linkpin
description: One chain strikes high and the second answers low a heartbeat later through the opened guard.

name: Eyeletglare
description: Glide so that each foot mirrors the swing of the opposite chain and the body stays centered.

name: Gustjoint
description: Catch the cut on one chain and let the other swing around to strike the cutter's wrist.

name: Rivetvalor
description: Two fields of qi tighten two chains about the foe in opposite turns so that no limb can slip free.

name: Vigilant Spineplate
description: Beat the chains in alternate time so that qi passes from one to the other and each swing is stronger than the last.

name: Gustrivet
description: The chains rise and fall in opposite arcs and every fall lands on the foe with the other chain's lift behind it.

name: Strangling Slither
description: Two rings of whirling chain overlap about the foe until any step or draw of breath meets iron.

name: Booming Hingebar
description: Both chains strike one point along opposite lines and the field's whole force passes through the foe's guard.

name: Granite Segment
description: Settle low with the long tail of the chain pooled around the feet like water in a basin.

name: Vitalrivet
description: Breathe slowly and send each breath into the chain until the tail is heavy with stored qi.

name: Blazerasp
description: Throw the loaded tail in a long arc and let the stored qi pour out as it lands.

name: Gust Whiplink
description: Move along the rim of an imagined basin with even steps that never spill the stored qi.

name: Verityeyelet
description: Feel the drag of the tail along the ground to know what stands behind and beside the wielder.

name: Rattleruin
description: Throw with the basin full to the brim so that the tip lands heavily and the surplus drives past the guard.

name: Hoarfrost Chainhead
description: Hold the stored qi in a ring around the wielder where it absorbs blows without spilling.

name: Ponderous Joint
description: The tail winds about the foe's legs and dams his movement as a bank holds back a stream.

name: Blaze Rivet
description: Tip the full basin over and sweep the tail across every foe within the wielder's reach.

name: Shade Coilend
description: Pour qi steadily down the laid tail so that its weight presses the foe's stance into the ground.

name: Rasp Reckoning
description: Empty the whole basin through the tip in one throw and drive the force through armor and guard alike.

name: Unassailable Linkpin
description: Stand angled to the foe as a river stands to its bank and let the chain curve about the body.

name: Titanic Rattle
description: Throw the chain in a bend that swings wide of the guard and curls in at the foe's flank.

name: Meteoric Tailblade
description: Turn on the spot in a small eddy so the foe's rush slides past and the chain swings round after it.

name: Rumble Spineplate
description: Pull the chain back along the current of the foe's own motion so the foe is carried off his line.

name: Verity Chainhead
description: Watch every side of the bend at once and mark which foe is closing along the bank.

name: Writhe Ruin
description: The chain meanders through three small bends in flight and arrives where the guard is thinnest.

name: Rattlemettle
description: Let the chain circle in an eddy around the foe's weapon arm and draw tight as it closes.

name: Murkeyelet
description: Send the chain low under a cut and lift it so the blade rides up and over the wielder.

name: Facet Slither
description: Bend the cast a second time near the target so the tip turns and slips into a narrow gap.

name: Downpour Whiplink
description: The chain surges around the bend like a flood and strikes every foe along the bank in one pass.

name: Numbing Rivet
description: Hammer the ground at the foe's feet with the chain until the footing crumbles and the stance sinks.

name: Deed Coilend
description: Lay the chain in a closed oxbow loop that tightens around any foot or wheel that enters it.

name: Blinding Jangle Glimmer
description: Hook a distant anchor and let the chain's bend haul the wielder across the gap in a single sweep.

name: Ironrivet
description: Grip the handle like a perch and hold the barbed tip out in front like a talon at rest.

name: Might Joint
description: Strike with the barb in a short raking dive that scores the foe's arm and shoulder.

name: Chime Rattle
description: Close the barb on the foe's belt or strap and pull so the foe's weight slides forward.

name: Lightning Tailblade
description: Hover on light feet just beyond the foe's reach and drop in only when the barb is ready.

name: Suffocating Jangle
description: The barb sets in the foe's gear and the chain winds round it so the foe cannot shed the hold.

name: Toxin Eyelet
description: Heave on the hooked chain with qi until the foe's heels leave the ground.

name: Torrent Hingebar
description: Spread the arms and swing the chain so its sweeping barb turns aside blows like a hawk's pinion.

name: Blaze Eyelet
description: Dive in with the barb leading and tear a long wound across the foe's guard and what lies behind it.

name: Ferocious Tailblade
description: Drive the qi-hardened barb through the plate's gap and grip the lining behind it.

name: Nova Rasp
description: Drive the barb through armor and hold the wound open with the chain while qi tears it wider.

name: Obdurate Segment
description: Hold both chains in slow circles at the sides so two orbits turn about the body unhurried.

name: Gust Chainhead
description: Let one orbit spin out into a throw on the beat and draw it back into the circle at once.

name: Writheglimmer
description: Turn the feet against the spin of the chains so the orbits never pull the wielder off balance.

name: Murk Coilend
description: Draw the inner orbit tight to the chest so that thrusts glance from the quick turning links.

name: Rumble Whiplink
description: Fling the outer orbit wide so the farther chain strikes from beyond the foe's expected reach.

name: Raspvalor
description: Drop both orbits over the foe so that the circles lock about the body at chest and knee.

name: Clairvoyant Spineplate
description: Weave qi through both orbits so they hum together and each swing carries the other's strength.

name: Thorn Linkpin
description: Turn both chains about one axis at the wielder's spine so the whole body sits inside a sphere of iron.

name: Rasp Havoc
description: Swap the inner and outer orbits in mid swing and strike from the side the foe was not watching.

name: Downpour Rivet
description: Spin both orbits faster and wider until a vortex of iron strikes all foes who stand about the wielder.

name: Immobilizing Segment
description: Draw the two orbits together into a net around the foe so that every move leads against a chain.

name: Rumble Slither
description: Collapse both orbits inward on the foe at the same instant with the full weight of the field behind them.

name: Granite Coilend
description: Stand ready with one track of effort in the body and one in the chain's segments.

name: Rattle Scourge
description: Throw by the body's turn alone and keep the qi track back for the next move.

name: Granite Joint
description: Slide on the qi track alone so the feet barely touch the ground while the body track rests.

name: Unerring Hingebar
description: Pulse qi down the chain one segment at a time so each link rings in turn as the swing runs on.

name: Unrelenting Joint
description: Run the body track and the qi track in two overlapping guards so a blow breaking one meets the other.

name: Tempered Writhe
description: Cast with the body track on the near half of the chain and the qi track on the far half.

name: Berserk Rasp
description: Drive the qi through the chain segment by segment so the last link arrives with the strength of all.

name: Silt Spineplate
description: Leave the chain laid in a track of qi on the ground so it closes about any foot that steps within.

name: Eviscerating Writhe Havoc
description: Bring body track and qi track down the chain together in one blow that splits shield and guard.

name: Flintlike Linkpin
description: Plant both feet facing the wind and hold the chain loose at the side to swear to the line ahead.

name: Shattering Chainhead
description: A short flick along the sworn bearing sends the tip straight to the foe's face.

name: Unseen Slither
description: Step forward only when the wind is behind and let it add its push to each stride.

name: Rivet Mettle
description: Draw the chain home along the bearing and the foe's grip follows it and loosens.

name: Verity Tailblade
description: Read the lanes the gale makes across the ground and find which of them a foe is walking.

name: Wrathful Rattle
description: Throw with the sworn line loaded in the qi so that the tip lands as if the oath had weight.

name: Gyverattle
description: Wind the chain around the foe and keep the bearing so the wrap holds whatever way he pulls.

name: Chime Hingebar
description: Swing the chain across a gust so the wind turns the cut aside against the line of the blow.

name: Rampaging Jangle
description: Swing the chain along the line of the gale so the sworn wind sweeps all foes in its path.

name: Ponderous Jangle
description: Hold the chain taut along the bearing so that foes pressing across it are driven to their knees.

name: Brutalizing Iron Whiplink
description: Send the sworn line straight through the gale and the foe's guard with qi no crosswind can turn.

name: Faceteyelet
description: Stand on the balls of the feet at the plateau's rim with the chain hanging into the updraft.

name: Tempered Slither
description: Throw into the rising air so the tip climbs and then falls on the foe from above.

name: Silt Writhe
description: Run the edge in short sure strides with the chain's weight leaning the body away from the drop.

name: Toxin Tailblade
description: Hook the foe's lead leg and pull toward the rim so the foe fears the drop and shortens the stance.

name: Gyveeyelet
description: Wind the chain about the foe's near arm and anchor the end so the foe cannot step back from the rim.

name: Equipoise Segment
description: Drop the chain over the rim line and swing it up so it meets a charge from below.

name: Tempered Eyelet
description: Time the cast to a surge of air and the tip rises past every guard raised at waist height.

name: Rattlewrath
description: Sweep the chain along the rim so that every foe on the edge is struck from the side.

name: Ponderous Spineplate
description: Wrap the foe and haul steadily toward the rim until balance fails and the foe goes down.

name: Gusteyelet
description: Hurl the full weight of the chain and body at the foe and drive him backward to the rim.

name: Iron Chainhead
description: Stand facing the far horizon with the whole length of chain laid out behind on the sworn bearing.

name: Lacerating Hingebar
description: Pay the chain out hand over hand as it flies so each segment adds its reach.

name: Vanishing Segment
description: Pace the open plateau in long even strides that eat the ground without tiring the legs.

name: Chime Rasp
description: Let a gust catch the loose chain and use its push to sweep the foe's guard to one side.

name: Chimejoint
description: Read the whole horizon through the chain's far end and mark every foe approaching across the plateau.

name: Facet Writhe
description: Qi pushes the tip a full stride past the chain's end and bites through a guard thought safe.

name: Overpowering Linkpin
description: Keep the bearing steady as the chain winds about the foe so the wrap holds against a struggle.

name: Adamantine Rivet
description: Swing the chain so a blow is parted like a gale against a standing stone and passes on either side.

name: Torrent Jangle
description: Draw in the extended chain with qi as the feet close the distance so no gap is left to exploit.

name: Joint Scourge
description: Swing the full length of the chain in a wide arc that reaches all foes across the open ground.

name: Siltjoint
description: Lay a length of the chain across the bearing so any foe crossing the line is caught and held.

name: Ferocious Rattle
description: Send the tip along the bearing at a distant foe with qi enough to pierce a raised shield.

name: Blistering Coilend
description: Throw the whole chain along the bearing in one line and the force lands at the far end undiminished.

name: Tailblade Durance
description: Hold the chain open at the side in the full wind with nothing at the wielder's back.

name: Rivetscourge
description: Throw with the wind and let it lend speed to the tip as it crosses the open ground.

name: Unseen Eyelet
description: Step across bare ground with no thought of cover so that no foe can read a hiding place.

name: Charter Hingebar
description: Hold an open guard of whirling chain that takes each blow on the move and gives it back to the wind.

name: Eyeletdurance
description: Throw the wrap into the wind so the gust itself carries the chain around the foe's body.

name: Raspmettle
description: Draw the chain through an open hand with qi so a hooked foe is dragged to the wielder.

name: Downpour Segment
description: Open the whole field to the wind and sweep the chain through every foe standing in the open.

name: Shadewrithe
description: Stake the chain's end in open ground and hold it so foes advancing against the wind lose heart and footing.

name: Gustrasp
description: Throw the chain in the full gale with the field wide open and the strike carries all the wind's weight.

name: Impervious Linkpin
description: Stand with one end of the chain wound about the wrist and the other trailing loose and ready.

name: Tempered Whiplink
description: Cast the chain out while the wrist end stays fast and the tip arrives on a taut line.

name: Granite Jangle
description: Take up or give out slack with each step so the tether never runs short or snarls the feet.

name: Toxin Rasp
description: Pull the tether taut with the whole body and the foe is dragged a step from his post.

name: Verityrivet
description: Hold the tether lightly and feel every shift of the foe's weight run back along its length.

name: Eyeletspine
description: The wind and a twist of the chain tie a knot about the foe's wrists that no strength undoes.

name: Rivetnerve
description: Swing the tether so it sings in the wind and the sound warns the wielder of any blow before it falls.

name: Mightjangle
description: Pull the foe onto the tip as it is thrown so the force of both motions meets in one blow.

name: Chime Slither
description: Loose the tether suddenly while the foe strains against it and the foe falls headlong.

name: Mayhem Writhe
description: Whirl the tether on its wrist end so that the loose iron strikes everything in a wide ring.

name: Silt Eyelet
description: Stake the tether's end in the ground and leave the rest lying so that a charging foe is snapped back.

name: Jointhavoc
description: Draw the tether back to the limit and release it so that the tip snaps forward with all the stored force.

name: Impervious Spineplate
description: Open the arms wide and let the chain hang between so that the wielder invites the foe in.

name: Might Rattle
description: Give ground one slow step at a time while the chain keeps the foe from pressing close.

name: Joint Wrath
description: Cast hard at the foe's lead foot and step into the ground the foe has just lost.

name: Clairvoyant Rivet
description: Look beyond the foe to the open sky and read the wind for what the foe is about to do.

name: Hoarfrost Whiplink
description: Wrap the foe and hold the chain as if sworn to it so that the wrap does not loosen.

name: Chimerivet
description: Give with a blow rather than stopping it and let the chain carry the force harmlessly aside.

name: Hogtying Rattle
description: Pull the foe back across the ground he gained until he stands where he began.

name: Daybreak Rivet
description: Sweep the chain out in a great arc that clears every foe from the ground just given up.

name: Lethal Chainhead
description: Leave chain on the ground as the wielder retreats so that pursuers trip into its loops.

name: Rattlehavoc
description: Hurl the chain at the foe with the whole oath behind it and win back every pace in one blow.
